review: Reviewed the complete 14-file delta from the physical capture revision. No SCAIL/WAN provider, forward, kernel, scheduler, tier-selection, tensor shape, dtype policy, or memory-strategy implementation changes. Cargo.lock only adds the existing serde dependency to candle-gen and tempfile to candle-layers dev dependencies.

The shared affine repacker retains its output formats: Q4 remains lossless and Q8 retains the existing CPU-upload recipe. The shared quantizer compacts logical views only when required; full contiguous operands retain their allocation and original algorithm. The fixed SCAIL capture uses valid contiguous/affine checkpoint operands, unchanged native formats, resident load policy, and physical axes. Regressions cover byte equality, mixed widths, strided/broadcast views, mutation and repair.

Checkpoint changes attach path/name/layout identities and the request cache to operands. They retain no additional checkpoint tensor storage or device tensors. Value-changing arithmetic clears immutable identity, and aliases share mutation invalidation. Runtime cache publication stages at most one projection of packed GGML bytes on the host; it does not introduce a full-component float copy or alter device residency/activation policy. Cache geometry checks read only already-mapped headers, never weight bytes.

The MLX implementation is unchanged. Its shared-contract digest changes because gen-core adds optional artifact invalidation and incremental borrowed identity hashing. The existing single-slice constructor retains exactly its previous key encoding, covered by a regression. No MLX native memory, model, scheduling, or execution policy changes.

This is explicit source-compatibility review of this exact immutable pair, not a new physical measurement or a claim about startup duration. Original capture revisions, receipts, host/device bounds, axes and uncertainty remain unchanged. Later inference changes need their own exact review or physical evidence.

The landed merge commit has the exact same Git tree as reviewed commit a27f10cd969f7fa04cbd115d6865336b054da310; provider and shared-contract digests and the complete capture-to-target delta are unchanged. This final target is reachable from inference main.
